mapper.sql: select content_id, content_key, content_name, title, subtitle, content, content_format, publish_status, sort_no, ext_json, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_site_content
mapper.select: where content_key = #{contentKey} and publish_status = '1' and del_flag = '0' limit 1

del_flag = '0' and content_key like concat('%', #{contentKey}, '%') and content_name like concat('%', #{contentName}, '%') and publish_status = #{publishStatus}
order by sort_no, content_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_site_content (content_key, content_name, title, subtitle, content, content_format, publish_status, sort_no, ext_json, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{contentKey}, #{contentName}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{content}, #{contentFormat}, #{publishStatus}, #{sortNo}, #{extJson}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update biz_site_content set del_flag = '2' where content_id in #{contentId}
